# Security policy

Found a vulnerability? Please email **mail@saranmahadev.in** before sharing it publicly. You will get a reply within three days.

Good-faith research is welcome: stay away from other people's data, do not degrade the service, and do not use social engineering. I will not take action against research that follows these rules. The reader-facing version of this policy, and what the site stores, is at https://blog.saranmahadev.in/security/.

In scope: the site (blog.saranmahadev.in), its Firestore rules, and its Cloud Functions. Out of scope: Google's own services and findings that need a compromised device or mailbox.
